Aisha (Product PM): quick sync: ACME asked for a 'slot prefill' capability to proactively load tenant model weights + KV prefixes before peak windows. They want a Q3 pilot with clear gating (latency, cost, security). Need runtime/infra/security alignment on feasibility and launch criteria.
Dan (Eng): clarify: per-tenant opt-in or blanket prefill? also how will product signal eligibility?
Aisha (Product PM): pilot = per-tenant opt-in. Product will mark tenants eligible; we also want an automated eligibility heuristic later based on traffic.
Priya (Runtime): runtime risks: memory + KV eviction if many tenants warmed; prefill interfering with batching; and ensuring warm state doesn't bypass correctness checks. Proposal: prefill controller that: (1) evaluates eligibility, (2) schedules prefill in off-peak window, (3) tags nodes with warm:tenant_id TTL. Soft caps + fairness queue.
Priya (Runtime): sample rollout config: ```json
{"prefill": {"enabled": true, "window": "01:00-04:00 UTC", "ttl_hours": 8, "max_concurrent": 10, "eligibility_score_threshold": 0.6}}
```
Jorge (Infra): infra questions: estimated GPU-mins per tenant prefill, whether prefill writes ephemeral checkpoints to disk, and if we need a separate prefill pool. FYI our cloud SKU lead time for capacity is ~72h if we request new hardware. I'll open infra-capacity ticket.
Dan (Eng): can runtime emit low-cardinality metrics for observability? suggested names: prefill_queue_len, prefill_success_rate, prefill_warmed_ratio, prefill_gpu_mins, warm_label_hit_rate. Add trace tag prefill=true for request paths.
Priya (Runtime): yes, will add those metrics aggregated by tenant class. Also emit eligibility_reason and failure_reason tags for failures (low-cardinality enums).
Lena (Security): confirm: prefill will be memory-only (no persistent model artifacts)? if KMS is touched we need audit & rate-limits. Also require an auditable opt-in event payload and a policy that prefill cannot access customer secrets.
Aisha (Product PM): correct memory-only. Product requires an opt-in audit event and a rejection path if tenant policy forbids prefill.
Lena (Security): security acceptance checklist: 1) opt-in/out audit events emitted; 2) code review of prefill path for secret access; 3) KMS rate limiting + audit hooks if used; 4) data handling doc signed off.
Dan (Eng): runtime acceptance criteria suggestion: - cold-start p95 for eligible tenants reduced >=35% on synthetic tests; - global p95 unchanged for non-eligible tenants; - prefill failure rate <1%; - cost delta <=7% for pilot. Rollback switch must drain queue and evict warm labels within 60s.
Priya (Runtime): add: prefill CPU/GPU overhead during peak <6% and prefill orchestration adds no retries that could affect live latency. We'll add a graceful backoff if cluster load > threshold.
Aisha (Product PM): proposed timeline: days 0-10 spike & prototype (runtime + infra), day 11 internal canary (7 tenants), 10-day canary validation with monitoring, week 6 external pilot. Tight but aligns with Q3 slate.
Jorge (Infra): noted. I'll include autoscaler knobs and node pool config in infra ticket. If we need new SKUs add ~72h lead. estimate: 30h (ticket + tuning) + possible 72h procurement.
Dan (Eng): ack 28est 28h: impl + tests + alerts29.
Priya (Runtime): ack 28est 52h: controller + metrics + feature flags + tests29.
Lena (Security): ack 28est 10h: review + policy signoff29.
OpsBot: deploy-bot scheduled job deploy/canary-prefill 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z -> will ping #eng-oncall.
Aisha (Product PM): thanks all. I'll draft the formal spec (eligibility heuristics, cost cap gating, and launch checklist) and slot into Q3. Please post any blockers here by EOD. :rocket:
